decision: Should Ghadeer extend active leak detection to Al-Rawdah and Al-Hamra next year?
decision_maker: Nadia Al-Rubaie, with the capital committee
options: Do not extend; repair on customer reports as now

estimand.population: District-months in the six districts, months 1 to 24
estimand.variable: Real losses as a share of system input (non-revenue water minus estimated apparent losses)
estimand.contrast: With active detection against without it
estimand.intercurrent: The Al-Wurud bulk-meter recalibration in month 13; read the months after it
estimand.summary: Difference in percentage points, Al-Wurud against the other districts, after against before

decision_rule: Extend if real losses fall by at least 3 percentage points in Al-Wurud relative to the other districts
affected: customers in districts with more interruptions during repairs
